# Country scope. Read-only coexistence guard for optional external auto-road mod variable (OGAS_Auto_Build).
# Never writes to OGAS_Auto_Build; strictly short-circuits via has_variable + trigger_if.
oe_road_ogas_active = {
	has_variable = OGAS_Auto_Build
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = OGAS_Auto_Build }
		var:OGAS_Auto_Build >= 1
	}
}

# Country scope. True when country can build at least one road type (vanilla or v9.6 imperial roads).
oe_road_has_any_road_tech = {
	OR = {
		road_type:gravel_road = { is_available_for = root }
		road_type:paved_road = { is_available_for = root }
		road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road = { is_available_for = root }
		road_type:oe_yam_post_road = { is_available_for = root }
		road_type:oe_via_imperialis = { is_available_for = root }
		road_type:modern_road = { is_available_for = root }
		road_type:oe_siberian_trakt = { is_available_for = root }
		road_type:railroad = { is_available_for = root }
	}
}

# Location scope (this = neighbor inside any_neighbor_location; prev = candidate source; root = country).
# Pure trigger pre-filter preventing already-upgraded hubs from starving remaining owned locations.
oe_road_prev_edge_needs_build = {
	# Policy 2 = Economic Basic Coverage: only build where NO road exists yet.
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { root = { var:oe_road_tier_policy ?= 2 } }
		NOT = { has_road_to = prev }
	}
	# Policy 1 (default) = Strongest Unlocked Road (7-tier deterministic ladder).
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { road_type:railroad = { is_available_for = root } }
		NOT = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:railroad } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { road_type:oe_siberian_trakt = { is_available_for = root } }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:railroad }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt }
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { road_type:modern_road = { is_available_for = root } }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:railroad }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:modern_road }
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { road_type:oe_via_imperialis = { is_available_for = root } }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:railroad }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:modern_road }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_via_imperialis }
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { road_type:oe_yam_post_road = { is_available_for = root } }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:railroad }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:modern_road }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_via_imperialis }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_yam_post_road }
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road = { is_available_for = root } }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:railroad }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:modern_road }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_via_imperialis }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_yam_post_road }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road }
			}
		}
	}
	# [V13.0_HOOK] Stage merges Andean imperial road tier check here.
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { road_type:paved_road = { is_available_for = root } }
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:railroad }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:modern_road }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_via_imperialis }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_yam_post_road }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road }
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:paved_road }
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		NOT = { has_road_to = prev }
	}
}

# Location scope (this = candidate neighbor oe_road_to; expects scope:oe_road_from and root = country).
# Evaluates whether the directed edge (scope:oe_road_from -> this) needs construction/upgrade under current tier policy.
oe_road_edge_needs_build = {
	# Policy 2 = Economic Basic Coverage: only build where NO road exists yet (kills num_roads = 0 cheaply).
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { root = { var:oe_road_tier_policy ?= 2 } }
		NOT = { scope:oe_road_from = { has_road_to = prev } }
	}
	# Policy 1 (default) = Strongest Unlocked Road (7-tier deterministic ladder).
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { road_type:railroad = { is_available_for = root } }
		NOT = {
			scope:oe_road_from = {
				has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:railroad }
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { road_type:oe_siberian_trakt = { is_available_for = root } }
		NOT = {
			scope:oe_road_from = {
				OR = {
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:railroad }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { road_type:modern_road = { is_available_for = root } }
		NOT = {
			scope:oe_road_from = {
				OR = {
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:railroad }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:modern_road }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { road_type:oe_via_imperialis = { is_available_for = root } }
		NOT = {
			scope:oe_road_from = {
				OR = {
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:railroad }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:modern_road }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_via_imperialis }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { road_type:oe_yam_post_road = { is_available_for = root } }
		NOT = {
			scope:oe_road_from = {
				OR = {
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:railroad }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:modern_road }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_via_imperialis }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_yam_post_road }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road = { is_available_for = root } }
		NOT = {
			scope:oe_road_from = {
				OR = {
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:railroad }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:modern_road }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_via_imperialis }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_yam_post_road }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# [V13.0_HOOK] Stage merges Andean imperial road tier check here.
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { road_type:paved_road = { is_available_for = root } }
		NOT = {
			scope:oe_road_from = {
				OR = {
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:railroad }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:modern_road }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_via_imperialis }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_yam_post_road }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road }
					has_road_of_type_to = { target = prev type = road_type:paved_road }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		NOT = { scope:oe_road_from = { has_road_to = prev } }
	}
}

# Location scope (this = neighbor candidate; expects scope:oe_road_from and root = country).
# Ensures every road segment grows outward from higher-proximity / capital / market / port / governor hubs (DAG spanning tree).
oe_road_valid_anchor_neighbor = {
	is_land = yes
	is_passable = yes
	has_owner = yes
	owner ?= root
	controller ?= root
	has_road_constructions = no
	is_connected_to = scope:oe_road_from
	oe_road_edge_needs_build = yes
	OR = {
		proximity > scope:oe_road_from.proximity
		is_capital = yes
		is_market_center = yes
		has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_col3_colonial_governor_palace
		AND = {
			is_port = yes
			scope:oe_road_from = { is_port = no }
		}
		AND = {
			root = { var:oe_road_mode ?= 2 }
			OR = {
				market_access > scope:oe_road_from.market_access
				is_port = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Location scope. Eligible source node with at least one valid anchor neighbor needing a road (pure trigger using prev).
oe_road_candidate_location = {
	is_land = yes
	is_passable = yes
	has_owner = yes
	owner ?= root
	controller ?= root
	has_road_constructions = no
	any_neighbor_location = {
		is_land = yes
		is_passable = yes
		has_owner = yes
		owner ?= root
		controller ?= root
		has_road_constructions = no
		is_connected_to = prev
		oe_road_prev_edge_needs_build = yes
		OR = {
			proximity > prev.proximity
			is_capital = yes
			is_market_center = yes
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_col3_colonial_governor_palace
			AND = {
				is_port = yes
				prev = { is_port = no }
			}
			AND = {
				root = { var:oe_road_mode ?= 2 }
				OR = {
					market_access > prev.market_access
					is_port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
